content: We collected Japanese-Vietnamese parallel data from TED talks extracted from WIT3's corpus BIBREF15 . After removing blank and duplicate lines we obtained 106758 pairs of sentences. The validation set used in all experiments is dev2010 and the test set is tst2010.
